_comment: Running handoff doc 01 for the next Epic 10 W4 SIT deploy cycle. This replaces stale deploy assumptions in older prompts and follows the Openclaw CI/CD process.
title: Redeploy Epic 10 W4 export/configurator updates to SIT and verify live wiring
lane: Copilot - deploy / runtime proof / post-deploy verification
objective: Deploy the latest dev snapshot of ai-accounting-copilot to SIT through the Openclaw control-plane workflow, then verify that the production-facing W4 surface on /phase2/prototype is serving the latest export/configurator implementation with real frontend-backend wiring.

non_negotiables: No direct VPS modifications outside the approved Git + GitHub Actions deploy path
Use the Openclaw control-plane workflow only
On failure, inspect workflow logs and runtime evidence before suggesting any new code change
Deployment proof must include commit SHA, workflow run, and verification result

repo_state_to_assume.freeze_gate_status: Formal checkbox close already committed in docs/ux/UX-FREEZE-EXPORT-CONFIGURATOR.md
repo_state_to_assume.quick_export_backend_status: Frontend now sends template_id:null plus column_overrides to /api/v1/export/preview and /api/v1/export
repo_state_to_assume.template_export_override_status: Template Export preview/download now send column_overrides for per-run edits
repo_state_to_assume.configurator_status: 3-tab configurator shell exists on main-ux-ui.html, but still needs live verification on SIT
repo_state_to_assume.index_status: index.html has been mechanically resynced from main-ux-ui.html and now needs real browser/static verification
repo_state_to_assume.known_non_blocking_note: downloadQuickExportCsv() and renderQuickPreview() remain as orphaned helper functions; they are no longer the primary bound path

what_to_do: 1. Trigger the Openclaw workflow Deploy ai-accounting-copilot SIT against dev.
2. Follow Procedure A discipline from Openclaw README: deploy first, then verify, and if anything fails, inspect logs before proposing fixes.
3. Watch the workflow steps and capture the run URL plus the deployed ref/SHA.
4. If the workflow fails, inspect the workflow sections in order and summarize the first real failing step, not a downstream symptom.
5. After a successful deploy, verify these routes with SIT auth in place: /phase2, /phase2/prototype, /prototype, /workflow-demo, /index.html, /api/health, /api/health/ready.
6. Verify that /phase2/prototype is the accepted production-facing W4 surface and not serving a stale shell.
7. Verify that /index.html does not visibly lag behind the accepted W4 surface after this deploy.
8. Verify that Quick Export now uses the real backend path, not the old client-side fallback behavior.
9. Verify that Template Export preview/download reflect per-run column edits through column_overrides.
10. Verify that the Configurator shows the 3-tab structure on the live production-facing surface.

focus_checks_after_deploy.name: Template Export per-run overrides
focus_checks_after_deploy.expectation: preview/download requests include column_overrides when the user adjusts columns

focus_checks_after_deploy.name: Configurator 3-tab surface
focus_checks_after_deploy.expectation: Upload & Detect / Configure Columns / Test Output visible on the production-facing surface

focus_checks_after_deploy.name: index.html parity
focus_checks_after_deploy.expectation: fallback/static route does not show the old pre-W4 export UX

if_workflow_fails_check_logs_in_this_ord: Workflow step: Provision SIT public edge
Workflow step: Run SIT smoke with auth
Workflow step: Capture DB/Redis/MinIO runtime evidence
acceptance_criteria: Workflow completes successfully against the intended dev ref/SHA
/phase2/prototype serves the latest W4 export/configurator artifact
/workflow-demo remains legacy-only and is not mistaken for deploy proof
/index.html does not show obviously stale pre-W4 UX
Quick Export uses the real backend null-template path
Template Export preview/download reflect per-run overrides
Configurator 3-tab structure is visible on live SIT
Final report includes workflow run, deployed SHA, route status, and remaining blockers if any

report_sections: If failed: first failing workflow/log step and exact blocker

final_instruction_to_copilot: Do the deploy and verification work end to end. Follow the Openclaw CI/CD procedure and inspect workflow/runtime logs before suggesting any new code changes. Do not stop at a plan.
